notes.purpose: Workspace MCP starter template for team-shareable, safe defaults.
notes.secrets: Do not store secrets here. Use environment variables and local machine secret stores.
notes.team_vs_local: Commit only safe shared entries. Keep machine-specific overrides in untracked local files.
notes.composition: Replace placeholders only after the repo has selected real MCP servers and reviewed their commands.

repo-context.description: Template for a repo context MCP server that exposes read-only search or documentation queries.

local-automation.description: Template for a local automation server with an explicit allowlist of safe commands.

browser-automation.description: Template for browser automation MCP. Review before enabling because it can interact with live sites, cookies, and local browser state.
risks: May expose cookies or session state

github.description: Template for GitHub MCP. Start read-only and require least-privilege tokens through environment variables.
risks: Write scopes can mutate issues, PRs, branches, or releases

database.description: Template for database MCP. Use local or staging read-only credentials only after data access review.

file-system.description: Template for file-system MCP. Constrain roots and start read-only.
risks: Over-broad roots can expose unrelated local files
Write access can modify source or secrets
Path traversal must be blocked by the server

apps.notes: MCP Apps are opt-in UI-returning tools. Start disabled until reviewed by the team.
